description: N. De Silva v. B.D. Karunathilaka N. De Silva v. B.D. Karunathilaka View More before Rohini Marasinghe, J.
parties: N. De Silva v. B.D. Karunathilaka N. De Silva v. B.D. Karunathilaka View More
keywords: Plaintiff sought ejectment of tenant on grounds of rent arrears. Defendant deposited rents at the Local Authority in the name of the deceased landlord, not the new landlord. Held - this violated Section 21 of the Rent Act, as payment under the wrong name does not discharge the tenant\'s obligation; Appeal allowed and the judgment of the District Court was set aside.
